svg.title: SAINTE-CHAPELLE — PALATINE CHAPEL SECTION & BAY ELEVATION
svg.desc: Transverse section and two-bay elevation of Sainte-Chapelle showing the 7.6 m lower chapel plinth, 20.6 m upper chapel vault, 15.0 m lancet glass, deep pier buttresses, and iron tension chains.
